title: opencode adapter
description: Managed block in ~/.config/opencode/AGENTS.md (core rules inline, router just in time) and five subagents (mode: subagent, inherit the calling model).
postInstall: opencode: the global AGENTS.md now exists, so opencode no longer falls back to ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md (it loads the first one found). opencode also scans every skills/**/SKILL.md under ~/.claude, which on Claude desktop includes the skills synced from claude.ai (~/.claude/skills/synced): their descriptions are added to every opencode session and duplicate names only warn. Our skills are also in ~/.agents/skills, so turn the ~/.claude scan off: export OPENCODE_DISABLE_CLAUDE_CODE_SKILLS=1 in your shell profile (Windows: setx OPENCODE_DISABLE_CLAUDE_CODE_SKILLS 1); this also hides project .claude/skills. opencode ignores disable-model-invocation, so opencode.json gets permission.skill deny for task-start, task-continue and handoff: the model no longer sees them, and /task-start, /task-continue, /handoff still work as commands (only keys you have not set are added). Subagents inherit the calling model; add model: provider/id to ~/.config/opencode/agents/*.md to route roles.
